newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: SOCCER-PSV GO BACK TO THE TOP.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-PSV GO BACK TO THE TOP.

text.p: PSV Eindhoven went back to the top of the Dutch first division on Tuesday when they beat 10-man Twente Enschede 2-0 at home with second-half goals by Philip Cocu and Boudewijn Zenden.
They lead Feyenoord, who play Groningen on Wednesday, by a point.
PSV, missing several key players, laid siege to the Twente goal after their skipper Jan-Nico Hoogma was sent off for his second yellow card offence after 37 minutes..
Cocu broke the deadlock in the 57th minute when he scored from close range from Zeljko Petrovic's cross.
Depleted Twente created several chances before Zenden killed off their challenge with PSV's second in the 84th minute. He cut in from the right and shot home from just inside the box.
